strategy: UR flashback/graveyard-value midrange with an extra-turn combo finisher (Galvanic Iteration copying Miracled Temporal Mastery)
identity: UR spells-matter deck: graveyard/flashback value engine (Thermo-Alchemist, Docent of Perfection, Burning Vengeance, Bedlam Reveler, Faithless Looting/Think Twice) with three independent win angles — incremental burn, token/anthem pressure, and a graveyard-scaling finisher — plus a bonus 2-extra-turn combo via Galvanic Iteration + Temporal Mastery.
